description: This Rust source file implements a terminal user interface (TUI) for a setup flow, including multi-select pickers, text input dialogs, and a setup wizard with step progress. It uses ratatui and crossterm crates for rendering and input handling, supporting interactive selection, navigation, and status updates within a terminal environment.

classes.name: PickerState
classes.description: Maintains state for multi-select list UI, including items, selection, and navigation.

classes.name: InputState
classes.description: Maintains state for text input dialog, including current value and handling key events.

classes.name: SetupWizard
classes.description: Manages the overall setup flow, including step progress, inline pickers, and message display.

methods.name: wrap_text
methods.description: Wraps input text into lines not exceeding max_width, preserving newlines.

methods.name: run_picker
methods.description: Runs an interactive multi-select picker in a terminal UI session, returning user selection or cancellation.

methods.name: run_picker_loop
methods.description: Main loop for the picker UI, handling rendering and input until user confirms or cancels.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the setup wizard with given step labels.

methods.name: update_step
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific setup step and redraws the progress.

methods.name: show_message
methods.description: Displays a message below the setup steps.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Temporarily exits the TUI mode, e.g., for browser-based auth.

methods.name: show_picker
methods.description: Displays an inline picker dialog and waits for user selection.

methods.name: show_input
methods.description: Displays a text input dialog and waits for user input.
